svg.title: Active-probe mechanism screen
svg.desc: Exploratory small-multiple forest plot of paired active-minus-clean task success for four carried probe mechanisms across Evolving-Intent GSM8K and BFCL models, with 95 percent paired-task bootstrap intervals.
svg.text: Paired task-success effect of carried active probes (active − clean); points with paired-task bootstrap 95% CIs; n = 20 tasks per point
Mechanisms are multi-dimensional and are not ordered as a complexity scale. Left is worse task success; right is better.
All probes use the same exact 15-character response envelope.
Intervals are unadjusted exploratory 95% bootstrap CIs (2,000 paired-task draws; seed 12,012). No multiplicity correction or monotonic trend test was prespecified.
DeepSeek appears only in Evolving-Intent; the completed BFCL replacement screen contains four models. Use this figure for mechanism generation, not confirmation.
